ISSUE_KIND: road_damage
ISSUE: Severe pavement collapse and sinkhole exposing an underground cavity in the street
DETAILS: The photo shows a large section of concrete road pavement collapsed into a deep sinkhole, exposing an underground brick structure, with wooden framework barricading and yellow caution tape placed inside, as well as a dislodged metal signpost leaning in the hole.
ORGANIZATION: Prince George's County
DEPARTMENT: Department of Public Works and Transportation, Office of Highway Maintenance, Road Maintenance Division
WHY: Tecumseh Street in Adelphi is located in unincorporated Prince George's County. Prince George's County Department of Public Works and Transportation (DPW&T) maintains local public roads in unincorporated areas of the county, including repairing sinkholes and road pavement failures.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "As part of the Prince George's County Roadway Preservation Program, maintenance includes the repair of sinkholes and potholes, shoulder repair, removal and replacement of concrete curb and gutter, sidewalks, driveway aprons, the installation of underdrains, the installation and/or upgrade of handicapped access ramps per ADA standards and the repair/resurfacing of the roadway pavement."
